messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: Oakridge (enterprise retainer) is requesting onboarding for a custom catalog reranker. They specifically want a private 13B with HSM-backed KMS, PHI/SSN redaction checks, and a regression + safety eval before we route live traffic. Renewal conversation in ~5 weeks so timing matters.

Tom: Thanks. Quick checklist link: https://redwood.internal/onboard-checklist. @Rohit can you own evals? We also need someone to coordinate private infra + key provisioning. Do they have labeled relevance pairs or a prompt set?

Rohit: I can run safety + regression. Need inputs: ~250 sample queries, relevance labels (binary or graded), and failure-mode notes (e.g., false positives that break checkout flow). Note that HSM onboarding usually adds 10-15 business days depending on their security CI. Also need token-length distribution (P50/P95) for tail latency planning.

Marta: I'll handle enablement and the enablement playbook. Suggest a staged rollout: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over a week, with automatic rollback if error_rate > 1.5% or latency_p95 > 900ms. I'll prepare a 20-min enablement session + runbook for their SREs.

Aisha: I'll request data and security contact from Oakridge. Renewal owner wants a go/no-go in 3 weeks; if evals don't start within 8 days we should flag renewal risk to sales.

Rohit: Proposed initial eval config:
```
eval_job: oakridge-rerank-v1
samples: 250
metrics: mrr@10, ndcg@10, latency_p95, error_rate
safety: pii_detection(SSN,PHI), hallucination_scan, toxic_lang
pass_thresholds: mrr_delta >= -0.02, latency_p95 <= 900ms, pii_leaks == 0
```
I'll do a smoke run once files land in s3://oakridge-onboard/inputs. If Oakridge asks for synthetic leakage testing or differential privacy checks, flag now.

eval-bot: queued job JOB-9022 for oakridge. Awaiting upload to s3://oakridge-onboard/inputs.

Tom: Adding account tag: needs-eval + private-hsm. I'll mark account health as WATCH and note potential renewal exposure if timeline slips. If data not uploaded by next Mon, I'll escalate.

Aisha: Pinged Oakridge legal/security for KMS contact and data export. Also asked for a sample of 250 queries and labeling guide. Will update thread when they confirm.

Marta: FYI I have a template runbook (private-deploy-reranker.md) I can tailor. Also recommend we include a tiny synthetic test set to validate PHI redaction automation.

Rohit: Good call. If we get the labeled set, I'll also run a short A/B with hosted reranker to validate delta; will post summary (tables + a short bullet list).

Aisha: Great—thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Oakridge today and share timelines here.
